validation.slug: Only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; it can't be a reserved word.
validation.format: Must include '{n}' and, if it restarts every year, also '{yyyy}'
validation.onePrimary: There must be exactly one primary issuer
validation.daysList: Whole days from 0 to 365, separated by commas (10 at most)
validation.rateNotGeneral: Outside the general regime, the rate must be 0%
validation.seriesCode: Up to 12 letters, digits or hyphens
validation.seriesFormat: It must include '{n}' and, if it has a year, '{yyyy}' or '{yy}'

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.pipelinePrev: Move the card to the previous stage
shortcuts.pipelineNext: Move the card to the next stage
shortcuts.pipelineDrag: Pick up and drop the card with the keyboard

modules.pipeline: Opportunity kanban with drag and drop, days in stage, next action and an analytics funnel.
modules.clients: List and 360° profile: contracts, invoices, deals, activity, LTV and tenure.
modules.quotes: Quotes with the same template as invoices and one-click acceptance.
modules.contracts: Contracts with one-off, monthly, yearly and usage-based lines, pauses, cancellations and milestones.
modules.invoices: Automatic drafts, bulk issuing, branded PDFs, payments and corrective invoices.

preview.onboardingDone: Preview: in the real app, this is where the organization gets created.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.empty: All caught up. This is where you'll see renewals, reminders awaiting approval and system alerts.

kinds.renewal: {client}: “{line}” renews on {date}, in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({amount} excl. VAT).
kinds.reminder_ready: Reminder ready for {client}: invoice {number} has been overdue for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({amount}). Review it and send it.
kinds.job_failed: Automatic billing on {date} failed. Check Invoices and run it again.
kinds.verifactu_deadline: {issuer} will have to issue invoices with Verifactu from {date}: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to go. A provider needs to be chosen.
kinds.verifactu_required: {issuer} has been required to use Verifactu since {date}: it can't issue invoices with the internal provider.
kinds.quote_accepted: {client} accepted quote {number} “{title}” online (signed by {signer}). The contract has been created.
kinds.portal_request: {urgent, select, yes {Urgent · } other {}}{client} asked for something from their space: “{subject}”.
kinds.new_device: {member} signed in from a new device: {device}. If you don't recognise it, remove it in Settings → Team.
kinds.site_down: {site} is down: {error, select, timeout {it doesn't respond in time} dns {the domain doesn't resolve} blocked {it points to a non-public address} refused {the server refuses the connection} reset {the connection drops} tls_expired {the SSL certificate has expired} tls_invalid {the SSL certificate isn't valid} redirects {it's stuck in a redirect loop} http {it responds with error {status}} other {it can't be reached}}.
kinds.site_up: {site} is back up (it was down for {duration}).
kinds.ssl_expiring: The SSL certificate for {site} expires {days, plural, =0 {today} =1 {tomorrow} other {in # days}} ({date}). Check the automatic renewal.
kinds.ssl_expired: The SSL certificate for {site} expired on {date}: browsers warn that the site isn't secure.
kinds.domain_expiring: The domain for {site} expires {days, plural, =0 {today} =1 {tomorrow} other {in # days}} ({date}). Renew it before the site stops working.
kinds.domain_expired: The domain for {site} expired on {date}. Renew it as soon as possible.
